# Run lead's corrections to the glosser's gloss.json (aeneid-094)

- Warriors killed by Turnus (asbyten, chloreaque, thamyrumque, sthenelumque, thymoeten, eumedes, etc.): the glosser called each "a Trojan"; the Latin gives only that Turnus kills them. Reworded "a warrior on Aeneas's side".
- glaucum, laden: sons of Imbrasus reared in Lycia (343–344) — "a Lycian on Aeneas's side"; laden's declension (-is) dropped as uncertain.
- comitatus (__broaden__): at 336 *dei comitatus* is the noun, nom. sg. collective in apposition to the plural subjects, not nom. pl.
